ev.q: investigated a case of lead poisoning in a boy aged 20 months
This report summarizes that case investigation
On follow-up at age 23 months, the child's BLL had decreased to 8 µ g/dL.
The ceramic plate released 29.6 µ g/mL of lead into the leaching solution
Follow-up at age 15 months documented a BLL of 18 µ g/dL.
Results for both were <5 µ g/dL, substantially lower than the child's BLLs.
a level exceeding the FDA compliance guideline of < 3 µ g/mL
This report summarizes that case investigation

methods_quotes.q: The plate was tested for lead by using an FDA protocol, whereby lead is extracted from the food contact surface
the plate was leached in a 4% acetic acid solution for 24 hours
The amount of lead released was measured by flame atomic absorption spectroscopy.
